run_docker_job: run a DockerJob container by passing a spec object with container_name and command fields
kill_docker_container: kill a running Docker container by calling docker_kill with the container ID
get_mapped_port: get the host-mapped port for a container's internal port using docker_mapped_port
get_container_ip: get the IP address of a running Docker container using docker_ip_address
wait_for_healthy: wait for a Docker container to pass its health check using wait_for_healthy
